## Context / Problem
`docs/ticket-model.md:288` and the comment `src/rebar/_commands/composer_edit.py:200-203` say `edit_ticket(tags=…)` is a deprecated alias; it was removed (`composer_edit.py:301-302`, CLI refusal `:422-426`; MCP `edit_ticket` has only `add_tags/remove_tags/set_tags`, `src/rebar/_mcp_writes.py:361-380`). `docs/plan-review-gate.md:113,122-123,1158,1183` teach `[operator-attested]`; ADR 0101 (`:33-49`) makes `[non-codebase]` canonical and keeps the old spelling as an accepted, UNDOCUMENTED alias (`tests/unit/test_guides.py:84-91` enforces this for the packaged guide). `docs/migrations.md:99` cites `init.py` for the ensure units, which live in `src/rebar/_commands/_init_ensures.py` (reachable as `init._<name>`, pinned by `tests/unit/test_init_ensures_seam.py:10-14`); `:256,:264,:293` cite bare `compact.py`/`_processors.py` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact.py`, `src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py`).

## Approach
- `docs/ticket-model.md:288-289` → "The library/MCP `edit_ticket(tags=…)` set-alias was removed pre-1.0; `tags` is rejected as an unknown edit field — use `add_tags` / `remove_tags` / `set_tags`."
- `composer_edit.py:200-203` → `# Tags are NOT an EDIT field (P2.3): they mutate via TAG_DELTA deltas` / `# (--add-tag/--remove-tag/--set-tags), so a whole-field EDIT can never clobber a` / `# concurrent tag add. The library/MCP edit_ticket(tags=...) set-alias was removed` / `# pre-1.0 (DE7); "tags" is now an unknown field, refused below.`
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md`: `:113` "NOT tagged `[operator-attested]`" → "NOT tagged `[non-codebase]` (ADR 0101)"; `:122-123` "The `[operator-attested]` tag matcher is single-sourced in `det_operator_attested` (`_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`…" → "The `[non-codebase]` tag matcher (which also accepts the legacy spelling) is single-sourced in `det_operator_attested` (`_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE`…" (symbol names are real, keep them); `:1158` "Items whose text begins with the `[operator-attested]` tag (ADR-0043)" → "…the `[non-codebase]` tag (ADR-0043, renamed by ADR 0101)"; `:1183` "an `[operator-attested]` AC item" → "a `[non-codebase]` AC item". Leave `:472` (a fixture name).
- `docs/migrations.md:99` → "(`_commands/init.py` is the entry point; the units themselves live in `_commands/_init_ensures.py` and stay reachable as `init._<name>`)"; `:256,:264` `compact.py` → `_commands/compact.py`; `:260,:293` `_processors.py` → `reducer/_processors.py`.

## Scope
`docs/ticket-model.md`, `src/rebar/_commands/composer_edit.py` (comment only), `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `docs/migrations.md`. Not: `docs/config.md` (config epic), `docs/adr/0086…:67` (overlap epic), `docs/adr/0059…:1009` (historical).

## Testing
`make lint` (ruff, comment hygiene, complexity ratchet — comment-only change scores nothing); `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check`; `pytest tests/unit/test_gen_ticket_model_taxonomy.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_unlink_documentation_contract_b6e1.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_docs.py tests/unit/test_plan_review.py tests/unit/test_s4_prompt_cutover_edge.py tests/unit/test_project_portability_docs.py tests/unit/test_det_floor_clarity.py tests/unit/test_llm_model_env_removal.py tests/unit/test_guides.py tests/unit/test_init_ensures_seam.py tests/unit/test_gen_ticket_model_taxonomy.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `grep -n 'deprecated alias' docs/ticket-model.md src/rebar/_commands/composer_edit.py` is empty.
- [ ] `grep -c '\[operator-attested\]' docs/plan-review-gate.md` = 0 and `grep -c '\[non-codebase\]' docs/plan-review-gate.md` ≥ 5 (four rewrites + `:318`).
